_comment: The committed credential grant of the loop-mutated components.
app_spec.xml, Trust Zone Isolation & Secrets, feature 148:
System grants loop-mutated components a credential set that rejects
every write to the immutable zone (docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md
section 2, the single most important line: agents write to Z1 only, and
Z1 has no credential for Z0 — enforce with filesystem permissions and
network policy, never with prompt instructions; section 1 P1: the
zone's contents are ones LLM-authored code has no write credential
for).
The compile in infra/security/loop_credentials.py refuses this file and
any change to it that puts a write-side operation onto any immutable
zone path — or onto any path covering one — so the sets below are not
a convention the next edit can forget: they are the law, checked.
The sets are deliberately full, not empty: both components hold real
write capabilities (their own Z1 work areas; the Z3 artifact drop
where proposed code lands), and the policy runtime holds read-only
grants on two zone members (section 5: feature definitions live in Z0
and are versioned). The signal sandbox holds nothing on the zone at
all, not even read — section 1 P4 keeps it fed by pre-sliced payload,
never by mount. A set that can truly write somewhere and still cannot
write the zone anywhere is the feature's own shape.
Paths are examples for the zone's shape, not real roots.
